description: Estimate maximum 223(f) proceeds as the lowest of: LTV (87% market, 90% affordable or 90%+ assisted), DSCR (1.15x market, 1.11x affordable) with debt service including the 0.25% annual MIP, the CY2026 statutory limit for the unit mix, and the cost-to-refinance or cash-out cap. Returns each test, the binding one, payment and MIP. If note_rate is omitted it uses the median note rate on 223(f) loans HUD endorsed in the last 12 months (realized history, not a quote). An estimate, not a commitment.

cost_to_refinance.description: Existing debt plus transaction costs and repairs, US dollars.

noi.description: Annual underwritten net operating income, US dollars.

name: size_223f
title: Size a HUD 223(f) loan (lowest of LTV, DSCR, statutory limit)
